name: hermes-agents-panel
description: Hermes Desktop plugin: Agents list under the sessions sidebar: every live chat, its state and its helper agents.

scripts.build: esbuild src/plugin.jsx --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --jsx=automatic --jsx-import-source=react --external:@hermes/plugin-sdk --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --minify --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* Agents panel for Hermes Desktop. Source: src/ in this repo. */" --outfile=agents-panel/plugin.js
